stories.title: 猴王的诞生
stories.sourceInspiration: Rise of the Monkey King — Part 1

sentences.chinese: 我亲爱的孩子，我知道时间很晚了。
sentences.english: My dear child, I know that the hour is late.

sentences.chinese: 你玩了一天，累了，现在是睡觉的时候了。
sentences.english: You've been playing all day and you are tired, and now it is bedtime.

sentences.chinese: 但是你说你想在睡觉前听一个故事。
sentences.english: But you say you want to hear a story before you sleep.

sentences.chinese: 所以现在我给你讲一个很老的关于猴子的故事。
sentences.english: So now I will tell you an old story about a monkey.

sentences.chinese: 这只猴子很强大，也很聪明，但是有的时候他也很淘气。
sentences.english: He was very strong and very smart, but sometimes he was also very naughty.

sentences.chinese: 他需要去学习什么是爱，去学习怎么去帮助别人。
sentences.english: He needed to learn about love and helping others.

sentences.chinese: 几千年以前这只猴子生活在中国的北方。
sentences.english: This monkey lived a thousand years ago in northern China.

sentences.chinese: 在他很长的一生中他有很多名字，但是他最有名的名字是孙悟空。
sentences.english: He had many names during his long life, but most people know him as Sun Wukong.

sentences.chinese: 人们讲了很多关于孙悟空的故事。
sentences.english: People tell many stories about Sun Wukong.

sentences.chinese: 如果我告诉你所有这些故事，需要讲很多天！
sentences.english: If I told you all those stories, I would have to talk for many days!

sentences.chinese: 所以今天晚上我会告诉你一点点关于他的出生和他怎么成为一个大王的故事。
sentences.english: So tonight I will just tell you a little bit about his birth and how he became a great king.

sentences.chinese: 一开始，在地球很年轻的时候，上天创造了四个大洲：东大洲，西大洲，南大洲和北大洲。
sentences.english: In the beginning, when the Earth was young, the gods in Heaven made four continents: the Eastern Continent, the Western Continent, the Southern Continent, and the Northern Continent.

sentences.chinese: 东大洲里有一个叫傲来的国家，离大海不远。
sentences.english: The Eastern Continent had a country called Aolai, near a great ocean.

sentences.chinese: 海中有一座大山，就像宫殿里的国王一样站在海中。
sentences.english: In the middle of the ocean was a great mountain that stood in the sea like a king in his palace.

sentences.chinese: 它的名字叫花果山。
sentences.english: It was called Flower Fruit Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 山的四周是美丽的森林，森林里有鸟，动物，绿绿的草，美丽的花，高高的果树。
sentences.english: Around the mountain was a beautiful forest. In the forest were birds, animals, green grasses, beautiful flowers, and tall fruit trees.

sentences.chinese: 百条小河从山中流向大海。
sentences.english: A hundred rivers came out of the mountain and flowed to the ocean.

sentences.chinese: 山顶上有一块很大的石头。
sentences.english: At the top of the mountain sat a very large stone.

sentences.chinese: 这块石头有六个大人那么高，三个大人也不能抱住它。
sentences.english: This stone was as tall as six tall men. Three large men could not encircle it.

sentences.chinese: 这块石头是在天地创造的时候同时产生的。
sentences.english: The stone was made at the same time as Heaven and Earth.

sentences.chinese: 这块石头每天吸收太阳和月亮的精华。
sentences.english: Every day the stone absorbed the essence of the sun and the moon.

sentences.chinese: 过了很多年，这块石头变成了一个有生命的东西。
sentences.english: After many years, the stone became a living thing.

sentences.chinese: 有一天，这块石头突然裂开了。
sentences.english: One day, the stone suddenly cracked open.

sentences.chinese: 从石头里跳出了一只猴子。
sentences.english: From the stone jumped a monkey.

sentences.chinese: 这只猴子向东南西北四个方向各拜了一拜。
sentences.english: The monkey bowed once to the east, once to the west, once to the south, and once to the north.

sentences.chinese: 然后他用眼睛看了看天空。
sentences.english: Then he used his eyes to look at the sky.

sentences.chinese: 两道金光从他的眼睛里射出，一直射到天上的宫殿里。
sentences.english: Two beams of golden light shot out from his eyes, all the way to the palace in Heaven.

sentences.chinese: 这两道金光惊动了玉皇大帝。
sentences.english: These two beams of golden light startled the Jade Emperor.

sentences.chinese: 玉皇大帝是天上的皇帝。
sentences.english: The Jade Emperor was the emperor of Heaven.

sentences.chinese: 玉皇大帝正在和天上的大臣们开会。
sentences.english: The Jade Emperor was in a meeting with the ministers of Heaven.

sentences.chinese: 他看到了从下界射来的金光，就问：
sentences.english: He saw the golden light coming from the lower world and asked,

sentences.chinese: "怎么会有金光从下界射上来？
sentences.english: "How can there be golden light shooting up from the lower world?

sentences.chinese: 快点派千里眼和顺风耳去查看一下。"
sentences.english: Quickly send Thousand-Mile Eye and Wind-Following Ear to investigate."

sentences.chinese: 千里眼和顺风耳是两个天上的将军。
sentences.english: Thousand-Mile Eye and Wind-Following Ear were two generals in Heaven.

sentences.chinese: 千里眼能看得很远很远，顺风耳能听得很远很远。
sentences.english: Thousand-Mile Eye could see very, very far away, and Wind-Following Ear could hear very, very far away.

sentences.chinese: 他们两个人立刻去查看。
sentences.english: The two of them immediately went to investigate.

sentences.chinese: 千里眼用他的眼睛一看，就看到了花果山上的猴子。
sentences.english: Thousand-Mile Eye used his eyes to look and saw the monkey on Flower Fruit Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 顺风耳用他的耳朵一听，就听到了猴子的声音。
sentences.english: Wind-Following Ear used his ears to listen and heard the monkey's voice.

sentences.chinese: 他们回来报告给玉皇大帝：
sentences.english: They came back and reported to the Jade Emperor:

sentences.chinese: "陛下，金光是从花果山的一只猴子眼睛里射出来的。
sentences.english: "Your Majesty, the golden light is coming from the eyes of a monkey on Flower Fruit Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这只猴子是从一块仙石里生出来的。
sentences.english: This monkey was born from a magical stone.

sentences.chinese: 他刚刚出生，正在拜天地呢。
sentences.english: He was just born and is bowing to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.chinese: 因为他吃了我们的仙丹，所以他的眼睛能射出金光。"
sentences.english: Because he ate our magical elixir, his eyes can shoot out golden light."

sentences.chinese: 玉皇大帝听了，说：
sentences.english: The Jade Emperor listened and said,

sentences.chinese: "原来是这样。
sentences.english: "So that's how it is.

sentences.chinese: 这是天地间的自然现象，不用管它。
sentences.english: This is a natural phenomenon between Heaven and Earth, don't worry about it.

sentences.chinese: 等这个猴子学会了说话和做事，我们再观察他。"
sentences.english: When this monkey learns to speak and act, we will observe him again."

sentences.chinese: 猴子在石头的旁边跑来跑去，跳来跳去。
sentences.english: The monkey ran around and jumped around next to the stone.

sentences.chinese: 他跑到东边的树林里，和松鼠一起玩。
sentences.english: He ran to the forest in the east and played with the squirrels.

sentences.chinese: 他跑到西边的草地上，和兔子一起玩。
sentences.english: He ran to the grassland in the west and played with the rabbits.

sentences.chinese: 他跑到南边的花丛中，和蝴蝶一起玩。
sentences.english: He ran to the flowers in the south and played with the butterflies.

sentences.chinese: 他跑到北边的小河边，和小鱼一起玩。
sentences.english: He ran to the small river in the north and played with the small fish.

sentences.chinese: 这只猴子在花果山上快乐地生活着。
sentences.english: The monkey lived happily on Flower Fruit Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他和山上的所有动物都成了好朋友。
sentences.english: He became good friends with all the animals on the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 猴子每天吃山上的果子，喝山下的泉水。
sentences.english: Every day the monkey ate the mountain's fruits and drank the spring water from below the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他的身体变得越来越强壮。
sentences.english: His body became stronger and stronger.

sentences.chinese: 他的动作变得越来越敏捷。
sentences.english: His movements became more and more agile.

sentences.chinese: 他的头脑变得越来越聪明。
sentences.english: His mind became more and more clever.

sentences.chinese: 过了很多年，有一天，天气特别热。
sentences.english: After many years, one day, the weather was especially hot.

sentences.chinese: 猴子觉得很热，就跑到山下去凉快凉快。
sentences.english: The monkey felt very hot and ran down the mountain to cool off.

sentences.chinese: 他来到一条小河边，看到河水清澈见底。
sentences.english: He came to a small river and saw that the water was crystal clear.

sentences.chinese: 猴子想："这水真凉快，我要下去洗个澡。
sentences.english: The monkey thought: "This water is so cool, I want to go down and take a bath.

sentences.chinese: 但是我不知道这水有多深。
sentences.english: But I don't know how deep this water is.

sentences.chinese: 我先找块石头扔进去试试。"
sentences.english: I'll first find a stone to throw in and test it."

sentences.chinese: 猴子捡起一块石头，扔进河里。
sentences.english: The monkey picked up a stone and threw it into the river.

sentences.chinese: 石头沉到了河底，猴子说：
sentences.english: The stone sank to the bottom of the river, and the monkey said,

sentences.chinese: "这水不深，我可以下去洗澡了。"
sentences.english: "This water is not deep, I can go down and bathe."

sentences.chinese: 猴子跳进河里，痛痛快快地洗了个澡。
sentences.english: The monkey jumped into the river and took a thorough bath.

sentences.chinese: 洗完澡，猴子觉得全身都很舒服。
sentences.english: After the bath, the monkey felt very comfortable all over.

sentences.chinese: 他抬头一看，看到河对岸有一座桥。
sentences.english: He looked up and saw a bridge on the other side of the river.

sentences.chinese: 猴子游过小河，走到桥上。
sentences.english: The monkey swam across the small river and walked onto the bridge.

sentences.chinese: 桥上有一个石碑，石碑上刻着三个大字：
sentences.english: On the bridge was a stone tablet with three large characters carved on it:

sentences.chinese: "花果山"
sentences.english: "Flower Fruit Mountain"

sentences.chinese: 猴子看到这三个字，很高兴。
sentences.english: The monkey saw these three characters and was very happy.

sentences.chinese: 他说："原来这座山叫花果山，这个名字真好听！"
sentences.english: He said: "So this mountain is called Flower Fruit Mountain, this name sounds really nice!"

sentences.chinese: 猴子走过桥，看到前面有一个山洞。
sentences.english: The monkey crossed the bridge and saw a mountain cave in front.

sentences.chinese: 山洞口有一块大石头，石头上刻着五个大字：
sentences.english: At the entrance of the cave was a large stone with five large characters carved on it:

sentences.chinese: "水帘洞洞天"
sentences.english: "Water Curtain Cave Heaven"

sentences.chinese: 猴子走进山洞，发现里面别有洞天。
sentences.english: The monkey walked into the cave and discovered there was another world inside.

sentences.chinese: 山洞里很宽敞，有很多石桌石凳。
sentences.english: The cave was very spacious, with many stone tables and stone stools.

sentences.chinese: 山洞里还有石床石碗，好像有人住过一样。
sentences.english: There were also stone beds and stone bowls in the cave, as if someone had lived there before.

sentences.chinese: 猴子很喜欢这个山洞。
sentences.english: The monkey really liked this mountain cave.

sentences.chinese: 他跑回山上，告诉所有的猴子：
sentences.english: He ran back to the mountain and told all the monkeys:

sentences.chinese: "我发现了一个好地方！
sentences.english: "I discovered a good place!

sentences.chinese: 那里有水，有桥，有山洞，我们可以在那里安家！"
sentences.english: There is water, a bridge, and a mountain cave, we can make our home there!"

sentences.chinese: 所有的猴子都很高兴，跟着猴子来到水帘洞。
sentences.english: All the monkeys were very happy and followed the monkey to the Water Curtain Cave.

sentences.chinese: 猴子们看到水帘洞，都很喜欢。
sentences.english: When the monkeys saw the Water Curtain Cave, they all liked it.

sentences.chinese: 他们搬进山洞，把山洞当成了自己的家。
sentences.english: They moved into the cave and made the cave their home.

sentences.chinese: 猴子们对这只发现水帘洞的猴子很感激。
sentences.english: The monkeys were very grateful to the monkey who discovered the Water Curtain Cave.

sentences.chinese: 他们说："你给我们找到了这么好的家，我们应该选你当我们的王。"
sentences.english: They said: "You found such a good home for us, we should choose you as our king."

sentences.chinese: 所有的猴子一起拜这只猴子为王。
sentences.english: All the monkeys together bowed to this monkey as their king.

sentences.chinese: 从此，这只猴子就成了花果山的美猴王。
sentences.english: From then on, this monkey became the Handsome Monkey King of Flower Fruit Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王每天带领猴子们在山上玩耍。
sentences.english: Every day the Handsome Monkey King led the monkeys to play on the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他们采果子，捉迷藏，跳水帘洞，过得非常快活。
sentences.english: They picked fruits, played hide and seek, jumped into the Water Curtain Cave, and lived very happily.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王很聪明，他教猴子们怎么种果树。
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King was very clever, he taught the monkeys how to plant fruit trees.

sentences.chinese: 他教猴子们怎么储存食物过冬。
sentences.english: He taught the monkeys how to store food for the winter.

sentences.chinese: 他教猴子们怎么制作简单的工具。
sentences.english: He taught the monkeys how to make simple tools.

sentences.chinese: 在美猴王的带领下，花果山的猴子们生活得越来越好。
sentences.english: Under the leadership of the Handsome Monkey King, the monkeys of Flower Fruit Mountain lived better and better.

sentences.chinese: 但是美猴王也有烦恼。
sentences.english: But the Handsome Monkey King also had worries.

sentences.chinese: 他看到老猴子会慢慢变老，会生病，最后会死去。
sentences.english: He saw that old monkeys would gradually grow old, get sick, and eventually die.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王想："我也会变老，也会生病，也会死去吗？
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King thought: "Will I also grow old, get sick, and die?

sentences.chinese: 我不想变老，不想生病，不想死去。
sentences.english: I don't want to grow old, get sick, and die.

sentences.chinese: 我要去找长生不老的方法。"
sentences.english: I want to find the method of eternal life."

sentences.chinese: 美猴王把这个想法告诉了最老的猴子。
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King told this idea to the oldest monkey.

sentences.chinese: 老猴子说：
sentences.english: The old monkey said:

sentences.chinese: "大王，你的想法很好。
sentences.english: "Your Majesty, your idea is very good.

sentences.chinese: 但是在这个世界上，只有神仙才能长生不老。
sentences.english: But in this world, only immortals can live forever.

sentences.chinese: 你要去学仙术，才能长生不老。"
sentences.english: You must learn the arts of immortals to live forever."

sentences.chinese: 美猴王问："哪里有神仙？"
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King asked: "Where are the immortals?"

sentences.chinese: 老猴子说：
sentences.english: The old monkey said:

sentences.chinese: "我听说在西牛贺洲有一座灵台方寸山，山上有一个神仙叫菩提祖师。
sentences.english: "I heard that in the Western Continent there is a mountain called Lingtai Fangcun Mountain, on which lives an immortal called Patriarch Bodhi.

sentences.chinese: 菩提祖师有很多弟子，他教他们仙术。"
sentences.english: Patriarch Bodhi has many disciples, he teaches them the arts of immortals.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王听了很高兴，说：
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King was very happy to hear this and said:

sentences.chinese: "好，我就去找菩提祖师学仙术！"
sentences.english: "Good, I will go find Patriarch Bodhi to learn the arts of immortals!"

sentences.chinese: 第二天，美猴王召集了所有的猴子，说：
sentences.english: The next day, the Handsome Monkey King gathered all the monkeys and said:

sentences.chinese: "我要离开花果山，去远方学习长生不老的方法。
sentences.english: "I am going to leave Flower Fruit Mountain and go to a distant place to learn the method of eternal life.

sentences.chinese: 我不在的时候，你们要听老猴子的话，好好生活。
sentences.english: While I am away, you must listen to the old monkey and live well.

sentences.chinese: 等我学会了仙术，我就回来教给你们。"
sentences.english: When I have learned the arts of immortals, I will come back and teach them to you."

sentences.chinese: 猴子们都很舍不得美猴王离开。
sentences.english: The monkeys were all very reluctant to see the Handsome Monkey King leave.

sentences.chinese: 但是他们知道这是为了大家好，就都同意了。
sentences.english: But they knew this was for everyone's good, so they all agreed.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王准备好行李，告别了猴子们，踏上了寻仙访道的旅程。
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King prepared his luggage, said goodbye to the monkeys, and embarked on the journey to seek immortals and learn the Way.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王乘着木筏，在海上漂流了很多天。
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King rode on a raft and drifted on the sea for many days.

sentences.chinese: 他经历了狂风暴雨，战胜了巨浪。
sentences.english: He experienced fierce winds and heavy rain, and overcame huge waves.

sentences.chinese: 最后，他终于到达了西牛贺洲。
sentences.english: Finally, he arrived at the Western Continent.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王登上陆地，走了很久，终于看到了灵台方寸山。
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King went ashore and walked for a long time, finally seeing Lingtai Fangcun Mountain.

sentences.chinese: 这座山很高，山上云雾缭绕，看起来就像仙境一样。
sentences.english: This mountain was very high, with clouds and mist swirling around it, looking just like a fairyland.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王很高兴，快步向山上走去。
sentences.english: The Handsome Monkey King was very happy and quickly walked up the mountain.

sentences.chinese: 他不知道，他的寻仙访道之路才刚刚开始。
sentences.english: He didn't know that his journey to seek immortals and learn the Way had just begun.

sentences.chinese: 美猴王的故事也才刚刚开始。
sentences.english: The story of the Handsome Monkey King had also just begun.
